title: Nuevo Laredo Announces Viveros Mágico 2026: Christmas Tree Lighting Dec. 5 at Parque Viveros
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo will light its Christmas tree and open Viveros Mágico 2026 on Friday, Dec. 5, at Parque Viveros, with more than 240,000 LED lights, a 20-meter tree and a circus show to open the city's December festivities, the mayor announced.
content:
Nuevo Laredo will light its Christmas tree and open Viveros Mágico 2026 on Friday, Dec. 5, at Parque Viveros, Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal announced, according to the Oficina de Corresponsales news agency.

The celebration marks the start of the city's December festivities, the mayor said, with the park transformed by more than 240,000 LED lights, 334 decorative pieces and a Christmas tree 20 meters tall, according to the report.

The opening night will feature Christmas Royal, a circus show by Producciones Atayde, combining acrobatics and entertainment to welcome the holiday season, according to the report.

Visitors will be able to walk through a 40-meter tunnel of lights and illuminated passages, past three-dimensional figures of Santa Claus, reindeer, penguins, snowmen, elves, bears and little trains, plus gingerbread houses, according to the report. The park will also include a Nativity scene, figures of the Three Kings, light arches, stars, giant spheres, bells, candies, piñatas and poinsettias.

The display will also highlight Tamaulipas identity, with figures of a couple dressed in the traditional cuera tamaulipeca, a map of the state and illuminated letters, along with themed photo spaces and a luminous “Feliz Año Nuevo 2027” sign, according to the report.

Sources: Oficina de Corresponsales, Nov. 18, 2026.
